title: Contact us
html:
Email PumpCadle668@outlook.com or call (269) 240-6135 during Weekday evenings, Eastern Time. Our usual first response time is within one business day. Please include the email used at checkout and your order number if you have one.

Orders and deliveries

For a change of address, tell us as soon as possible which order needs updating. For a missing item, say what arrived and what is missing so we can check whether the order was split. For damage or a wrong item, describe what you received. We can look up an order if you have lost the confirmation.

Billing

For a billing question, give the date and amount on your statement and whether the charge is pending or posted.

Written complaints

Write to 36 W Michigan Ave, Battle Creek, MI 49017, USA or email PumpCadle668@outlook.com. Tell us what happened, any prior case number and the outcome you seek. For a privacy request, email PumpCadle668@outlook.com. Keep passwords, one-time codes and full card numbers out of your message.
